title: Remove All Occurrences of Element

content.problemStatement:
Delete an element

Write a program to remove an element from the array
content.inputFormat:
First line has an integer N denotes the number of elements.

Second line has the N values.

Third line contains the elements to be deleted

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Remove all occurrences of value K from the array.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    val = toks[n+1]
    arr = [x for x in toks[1:n+1] if x != val]
    print(" ".join(arr))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Filter out elements equal to K and print remaining elements space-separated.
